title: Microsoft Edge: upgraded Copilot new tab page, off by default
summary: The controls, default state and rollout details are supported, and the briefing accurately reports Microsoft's differing statements about unlicensed users. One minor licensing qualification is needed: Microsoft's separate licensing page also lists Microsoft 365 E7 as including Copilot.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The service description calls Microsoft 365 Copilot an add-on plan with licensing prerequisites, supporting the briefing's add-on model.
claims.quote: Microsoft 365 Copilot is an add-on plan with specific licensing prerequisites.
claims.fix: Keep the cited service-description statement and add: 'Microsoft's separate licensing page also says Microsoft Copilot is available with Microsoft 365 E7 or as an add-on for eligible plans.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/copilot/plan/copilot-license-options, which states 'Microsoft Copilot is available with Microsoft 365 E7 or as an add-on for eligible commercial, US Government, and education subscription plans.'

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: No separate new-tab-page price or meter is published in the feature and licensing material checked.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Copilot new tab page separate price meter licensing cost Edge'. Read configure page, CopilotNewTabPageEnabled, Copilot service description, copilot-license-options and pay-as-you-go meters excerpt. No separate new-tab-page price or meter found.

claims.claim: The cited configure, policy and service-description pages do not state a Copilot add-on price.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Copilot new tab page separate price meter licensing cost Edge'. Read the configure page, CopilotNewTabPageEnabled and Microsoft Copilot service description in full; none states a Copilot add-on price.

claims.claim: Verification uses edge://policy > Reload Policies to check that CopilotNewTabPageEnabled shows TRUE, followed by a browser restart and new-tab check.
claims.quote: navigate to edge://policy on a targeted device and click Reload Policies to fetch changes. Verify that the CopilotNewTabPageEnabled policy values show as TRUE, then restart the browser. ... Open a new tab and verify that the new tab page is showing the updated Copilot experience.

claims.claim: The management-service route and CopilotNewTabPageEnabled configure the same new-tab-page availability.
claims.quote: The availability of the Copilot New Tab Page can be configured through the CopilotNewTabPageEnabled policy.

claims.claim: Access to browser context is a separately configurable Copilot setting.
claims.quote: use each dropdown to select Enabled or Disabled ... Access to browser context: Allows Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat to use a user’s browser context, such as page content, to provide contextual responses.

claims.claim: The Copilot icon in the toolbar is a separately configurable setting.
claims.quote: use each dropdown to select Enabled or Disabled ... Copilot icon in the toolbar: Shows the Copilot icon in the Microsoft Edge for Business toolbar.

claims.claim: The Copilot search box is a separately configurable setting.
claims.quote: use each dropdown to select Enabled or Disabled ... Copilot search box: Shows a search box on the new tab page where users can chat with Copilot and search with Bing Autosuggest.

claims.claim: AI-generated text and editing is a separately configurable setting.
claims.quote: use each dropdown to select Enabled or Disabled ... AI-generated text and editing: Provides AI-generated text creation and editing for eligible text fields.

claims.claim: The Learn pages do not explain how the separate Copilot search box setting interacts with the Copilot new tab page setting.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Edge management Copilot search box Copilot new tab page interaction settings'. Opened Configure the Copilot new tab page and Configuring Copilot Features; both describe settings, but neither explains their interaction.
